svg.data-memory: 2x16GB DDR4 SO-DIMM with ECC (Standard); 2x32GB DDR4 SO-DIMM with ECC (Premium)
svg.data-optics-qsfp-dd: 800GE QSFP-DD OpenZR+/ZR/2xLR4/2xFR4/DR8+/DR8/SR8; 400GE QSFP-DD OpenZR+/ZR/ER4/LR4/FR4/SR8/DR4/DR4+; 100GE QSFP-DD ZR+ (datasheet Compatible Transceivers Types)
svg.data-transceivers-sfp56: 50GE SFP56 SR/LR/ER; 25GE SFP28 SR/LR/ER; 10GE SFP+ SR/LR/ER; 1GE SFP SX/LX (datasheet Compatible Transceivers Types). Filed under this key rather than the house `optics-sfp56` because `sfp56` is not one of the pluggable-cage media tokens L40 harvests, so an `optics-` key here would join to nothing. THAT WORKAROUND IS NOT MINE - it was worked out on library/devices/ufispace/s9620-54dc, whose own attrs carry the same key and the same explanation, and is followed here so the two sibling platforms file the same fact the same way
svg.data-timing: Stratum 3E OCXO; ITU-T Synchronous Ethernet (SyncE); IEEE 1588v2 (Default Profile, G.8265.1, G.8275.1, G.8275.2); T-TC, T-BC/OC, T-GM; Class C timing accuracy; internal GNSS receiver for master clock
svg.data-macsec: hardware-accelerated MACsec and IPsec across all ports, Layer 2 and Layer 3
svg.data-tsn: Time Sensitive Networking for low packet loss and low delay variation
svg.data-nos-caveat: NOS integration is necessary to activate the specific feature; some features need an additional licence (datasheet footnotes, carried rather than dropped)
svg.data-timing-cables: 50 ohm SMA coaxial with 1/4-36UNS-2B for GNSS; 50 ohm SMB coaxial with 10-32UNF-2A for 1PPS and 10MHz; shielded RJ45 for ToD; shielded RJ48 for BITS
svg.data-timing-inputs: 1x GNSS input SMA, 1x 10MHz input/output SMB, 1x 1PPS input/output SMB, 1x ToD input/output RJ45, 1x BITS input RJ48
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15 Subpart B Class A; ICES-003 Class A; EN 55032 Class A; EN 300 386; EN 55035; EN 301 489; EN 303 413; VCCI CISPR 32 Class A

g.data-description: ToD input/output on RJ45, upper jack of the stacked timing pair; the datasheet specifies a shielded RJ45 cable for it

g.data-description: BITS input on RJ48, lower jack of the stacked timing pair; the datasheet specifies a shielded RJ48 cable for it. Drawn with std/rj45-ganged because RJ48 shares the 8-position modular opening and the library has no RJ48 part
g.title: bits

g.data-description: 1PPS input/output on SMB, 50 ohm with a 10-32UNF-2A connector
